transport: one process per test vector; test vector JSON on stdin; one result JSON on stdout

input.semantics: The adapter creates an isolated fixture, performs steps in order and returns only observables. An adapter exception is a test failure, never a security PASS.

fixture_requirements: fresh authority keypair and trusted-key registry per vector unless fixture explicitly imports material
fresh nonce store, audit ledger, failure ledger and resource root
effect counter incremented only by the privileged resource operation
no shared mutable state between vectors

comparison.mode: expected is a required subset of observed
comparison.stdout_policy: exactly one JSON document; diagnostics belong on stderr
